title: Narrowing a Datetime cast floors
description: `cast(pl.Datetime("ms"))` of a `Datetime("us")`, and `cast(pl.Datetime("us"))` of a `Datetime("ns")`, floor the count: -1 us is -1000 us at ms, -1 ns and -1500 ns are -1 us and -2 us. The in-memory and the streaming engine agree.
reference: D61: a cast to a coarser precision floors on the timeline (`date_trunc`); from nanoseconds it is the floor of the count divided by 1000.

provenance.notes: Polars 2.1.0 (Python), collected with engine="in-memory" and engine="streaming".
